audit.description: Changed production code in growthbook/growthbook.py replaces aiohttp imports with import httpx and uses real httpx APIs including httpx.AsyncClient, httpx.Client, response.aiter_lines(), httpx.HTTPStatusError, httpx.TimeoutException, and httpx.RequestError. The static evidence reports imports_target=true and imports_source=false for growthbook/growthbook.py, and dynamic evidence shows 23 target events from production repo with httpx resolving from site-packages while source import counts from repo and production repo are zero. No local target provider is indicated: target_local_spec_count is 0 and static checks report target_provider_added=false and fake_target_added_code=false.
evidence: growthbook/growthbook.py diff: removed import aiohttp and aiohttp.client_exceptions imports; added import httpx.
growthbook/growthbook.py diff: _init_session uses httpx.AsyncClient(...).stream("GET", url) and catches httpx.HTTPStatusError, httpx.TimeoutException, and httpx.RequestError.
growthbook/growthbook.py diff: FeatureRepository._get uses httpx.Client(follow_redirects=True).get(url); _fetch_and_decode_async uses httpx.AsyncClient(...).get(url).
anti_cheat_static file_checks: growthbook/growthbook.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false, source_namespace_access=false, target_provider_added=false, fake_target_added_code=false.

anti_cheat_dynamic metrics: target_event_count=23, target_events_from_production_repo_count=23, source_imports_from_production_repo_count=0, target_local_spec_count=0, httpx origin is site-packages/httpx/__init__.py.
reasons: Production code meaningfully uses httpx APIs for sync and async HTTP paths.
Changed production code shows no direct aiohttp import or namespace use.
Dynamic evidence resolves httpx from installed site-packages, not a local shim.
Static checks report no fake target provider or sys.modules aliasing.
